title: ComplianceDocs receives hardcoded isManager={true} -- all users can upload and deactivate documents
detail: Line 252: `<ComplianceDocs ... isManager={true} .../>`. The `isManager` prop controls whether the Upload Document button and the Mark Inactive buttons are rendered. By hardcoding `true`, every user (including Viewers) sees and can use these actions. The component destructures `isAdmin, isManager` from usePortalUser at line 119 but passes a hardcoded true instead of the actual role check.
evidence: LocationDetail.jsx:252 `isManager={true}`, :119 destructures actual isAdmin/isManager but does not pass them.

title: Primary location fetch failure in reload() throws unhandled -- secondary fetches silently swallowed
detail: Line 133-161: `reload()` calls apiGet for the primary location record without try/catch. If this fails (e.g. 404 for deleted location), the error propagates to the useEffect catch on line 166 which sets `error`. However, the three secondary Promise.allSettled fetches (detail, docs, appliances) have their rejections handled via the 'fulfilled' check -- but no user notification if they fail. A user can land on a location page where the property info loads fine but docs/appliances silently return empty arrays due to a permissions error, and the user sees 'No compliance documents found' instead of an error message.
evidence: LocationDetail.jsx:138 Promise.allSettled, :143-145 fulfilled checks -- rejected results set to null silently.
recommendedFix: Add a toast notification for each rejected secondary fetch: `if (detRes.status === 'rejected') toast.show('warn', 'Could not load facility details');` etc. This alerts the user without blocking the page.

title: handleDeactivate in AppliancesTab has no try/catch -- user sees unhandled error on failure
detail: Lines 530-533: `async function handleDeactivate(id) { await apiPatch(...); if (onReload) onReload(); }`. No try/catch block. If the PATCH fails (e.g. permissions, network), the error is unhandled and propagates as an uncaught promise rejection. The button click gives no feedback on failure.
recommendedFix: Wrap in try/catch: `try { await apiPatch(...); toast.show('ok', 'Appliance removed'); if (onReload) onReload(); } catch(e) { toast.show('err', 'Failed to remove appliance'); }`.

title: handleMarkInactive has no try/catch and no await on reload()
detail: Lines 186-189: `async function handleMarkInactive(docId) { await apiPatch(...); reload(); }`. No try/catch, so a PATCH failure is an unhandled rejection. Also `reload()` is called without await, so any reload error is also unhandled.
evidence: LocationDetail.jsx:186-189 -- no error handling on mark-inactive.
recommendedFix: Add try/catch with toast error surface, and await the reload call.

title: AppliancesTab appliance type fetch has bare .catch(() => {}) -- silent failure
detail: Line 509: `.then(r => setTypes(r?.value ?? [])).catch(() => {});` -- if the appliance types query fails, the types dropdown is empty and the user cannot add an appliance. No error message is shown.
recommendedFix: Add toast warning in catch: `.catch(() => toast.show('warn', 'Could not load appliance types'));`.
